music_runtime_audio_locked: Turn on sound first: browsers only allow sound after a tap.
music_runtime_audio_piano_failed: The sampled piano didn't load ({error}). Using Warm synth.
music_runtime_clips_aero_long_play: Hold a written {g} for 8 seconds. Keep it steady for the first 4, then add vibrato for the last 4.
music_runtime_clips_aero_octave_play: Jump from written {c4} up to {c5} and back, 3 times. Only the octave key moves.
music_runtime_clips_aero_scale_play: Sax tone. Play the written {c} major scale up one octave, one note a second.
music_runtime_clips_aero_tongued_play: Play written {c}, {d}, {e}, {f}, {g}, two notes a second. Start each note with your tongue.
music_runtime_clips_bends_play: {g} string, fret 7 (the note {d}). Pick, push the string up until it sounds like {d_sharp}, let it back down. Then pick again and push further, up to {e}, and let it back.
music_runtime_clips_c_scale_fast_play: The same scale, up and back down, at two notes a second.
music_runtime_clips_c_scale_fast_title: {c} major scale, two notes a second
music_runtime_clips_c_scale_slow_play: Play the {c} major scale in open position, up and back down. One note a second.
music_runtime_clips_c_scale_slow_title: {c} major scale, one note a second
music_runtime_clips_fingerpick_play: Hold {c}. Your thumb plays string 5, then string 4, on the beats. Your index picks string 3 and your middle picks string 2 in between. Play the bar 4 times.
music_runtime_clips_g33_play: The same {g} with your ring finger on the {b} string, fret 3. Strum down 4 times, slowly, and let each strum ring.
music_runtime_clips_guitar_click_play: Take your headphones off and turn the metronome on below. Strum {g} 4 times, one strum every 2 clicks.
music_runtime_clips_guitar_click_title: {g} with the metronome through the speakers
music_runtime_clips_hum_play: Hum one comfortable note and hold it steady.
music_runtime_clips_input_blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site, then tick the input again.
music_runtime_clips_input_missing: This input isn't connected. Plug it in, then tick it again.
music_runtime_clips_muted_play: Rest your left hand flat across all six strings without pressing. Strum down 4 times: a dry click, no notes.
music_runtime_clips_open_strings_guitar_: Pluck each open string once, from the low {e} string to the high {e} string. Let each one ring for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_open_strings_ukulele: Pluck each open string once, from the {g} string to the {a} string. Let each one ring for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_pattern_guitar_title: {g} with a strum pattern at 80 BPM
music_runtime_clips_pattern_play: Hold {chord} and strum down, down-up, up-down-up for 4 bars. Keep your hand moving down on every beat and up on every "&", and miss the strings where there's no arrow.
music_runtime_clips_pattern_ukulele_titl: {c} with the island strum at 80 BPM
music_runtime_clips_piano_bass_play: Left hand plays one low note, right hand plays the triad above it: {c2} with {c}, {f2} with {f}, {g2} with {g}. Hold each for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_piano_low_play: Play {c2}, {e2}, {g2} and {c3}, two octaves below middle {c}. One note every 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_piano_sevenths_play: Play each chord with all four notes. Hold each one for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_piano_triads_play: Play each chord with three notes, root at the bottom. Hold each one for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_piano_two_octaves_pl: Play the {c} major scale up two octaves and back down, two notes to each click.
music_runtime_clips_piano_white_play: Play the white keys from middle {c} up to the next {c}. One note a second.
music_runtime_clips_progression_play: Play {chords}: one down-strum on every beat, 4 beats on each chord.
music_runtime_clips_room_click_play: Play nothing. Take your headphones off, turn the metronome on below and let it click through the speakers.
music_runtime_clips_room_silence_play: Play nothing and stay quiet. This records the room on its own.
music_runtime_clips_room_talking_play: Talk normally for the whole clip, with no instrument.
music_runtime_clips_slow_strums_guitar_p: Strum down across the strings 4 times, slowly. Let each strum ring for 2 seconds.
music_runtime_clips_slow_strums_ukulele_: Strum down across the strings 4 times, slowly. Let each strum ring for a second and a half.
music_runtime_clips_solfege_play: Sing up the major scale on the syllables, one note a second. Start on any note that's comfortable.
music_runtime_clips_solfege_syllables: do re mi fa so la ti do
music_runtime_clips_uke_scale_play: Play the {c} major scale up from the open {c} string. One note a second.
music_runtime_clips_uke_scale_title: {c} major scale from the open {c} string
music_runtime_clipspage_allow_intro: Allow the microphone and Woodshed lists every input by name.

match.countPlural=one: This clip is already saved for {inputs}. Recording again replaces that file when you save.
match.countPlural=other: This clip is already saved for {inputs}. Recording again replaces those files when you save.

music_runtime_clipspage_choose_folder_fi: Choose a folder to save the take in.
music_runtime_clipspage_choose_hint: Choose {path} in the project. Takes already in it show in the grid.
music_runtime_clipspage_clipped: Clipped. Turn this input down and record again.
music_runtime_clipspage_grid_allow: Allow the microphone to see a column for each input.
music_runtime_clipspage_headphones_hint: Wear headphones for the click, so the recording holds your playing alone.
music_runtime_clipspage_intro: 42 short clips for testing how Woodshed hears your instruments. Each take records every ticked input at once and saves as WAV files in your folder. Nothing here counts as practice.
music_runtime_clipspage_let_ring_then_sp: Let the last note die away, then press Space.
music_runtime_clipspage_mic_position_pla: Laptop on the desk, 60 cm from the guitar
music_runtime_clipspage_no_input: No audio input found. Plug one in, then try again.
music_runtime_clipspage_no_picker: This browser can't save into a folder. Each take downloads as a WAV file. Move the files into {path} yourself.
music_runtime_clipspage_not_connected: Not connected today: {inputs}. Plug it in to record its missing clips.
music_runtime_clipspage_notes_after_fold: Saved to notes.json once you choose a folder.
music_runtime_clipspage_notes_label: Anything you played differently in clip {number}
music_runtime_clipspage_notes_placeholde: A wrong note, a skipped strum
music_runtime_clipspage_notes_saving: Saves to notes.json as you type.
music_runtime_clipspage_nothing_recorded: Nothing was recorded. Check that an input is ticked and its meter moves, then record again.
music_runtime_clipspage_nothing_to_hear: Nothing to hear for this clip.
music_runtime_clipspage_review: Clip {number}: listen back, then save the take or record again.
music_runtime_clipspage_space_hint: Space starts and stops. Wait for the cue, play, and let the last note die away.
music_runtime_clipspage_space_when_done: Press Space when the last note has died away.
music_runtime_clipspage_speakers_hint: Play the click through the speakers: this clip tests how the microphone hears it.
music_runtime_clipspage_take_not_saved: The take didn't save: {error}. Choose the folder again, then save the take.
music_runtime_clipspage_take_saved_last: Take saved: {file}. That was the last clip.
music_runtime_clipspage_tick_intro: Tick the inputs to record. Play at your loudest and keep every meter out of the red.
music_runtime_clipspage_tick_to_record: Tick an input above to record.
music_runtime_clipspage_very_quiet: Very quiet. Check this input heard you.
music_runtime_clipvisual_fingering: Fingering for written {note}. Notes are written pitch: finger them as you read them, whatever the transpose setting.
music_runtime_clipvisual_left_hand: The lowest lit key is for your left hand. The three above it are for your right.
music_runtime_clipvisual_pick_note: Pick a note above to see its fingering.
music_runtime_clipvisual_steps_label: Steps of this clip, in order
music_runtime_clipvisual_tab_label: Tab for one bar: thumb on strings 5 and 4 on the beats, index on string 3 and middle on string 2 in between
music_runtime_clipvisual_tab_note: T is your thumb, i your index finger, m your middle finger. The numbers are frets. The top line is the high {e} string.
music_runtime_lab_blurb: Play freely. Everything is recorded with real note lengths and saved as a take. Nothing is scored.
music_runtime_lab_level_hint: Level shows here once the microphone is on or a MIDI note arrives. On-screen taps have no velocity.
music_runtime_lab_no_takes: No takes yet. Start recording and play anything. It lands here.
music_runtime_lab_nothing_saved: Nothing was played, so nothing was saved.
music_runtime_lab_recording_status: Recording. Play anything. Stop saves the take.

match.countPlural=one: Saved {name}: {count} notes. Logged as free practice.
match.countPlural=other: Saved {name}: {count} notes. Logged as free practice.

match.countPlural=one: {count} distinct notes, {range}. Logged as free practice. Free play is never scored.
match.countPlural=other: {count} distinct notes, {range}. Logged as free practice. Free play is never scored.

music_runtime_mic_blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site (the icon in the address bar), then try again.
music_runtime_mic_no_access: This browser has no microphone access.
music_runtime_mic_not_found: No microphone found. Plug one in, or pick another input on Connect.
music_runtime_midi_no_sysex: SysEx wasn't allowed ({reason}), so MPC pad lights and the controller link are off. Plain MIDI works.
music_runtime_midi_unsupported: Web MIDI is unavailable in this browser. Use a Chromium browser, or the microphone and on-screen input.
music_runtime_record_intro: Capture a take, listen back, and keep what is worth keeping. Takes stay in this browser and are in your backups.
music_runtime_songs_edit_intro: Fix wrong notes in {title}. Tap a part to draw on it. The parts, key and sections stay as they were.
music_runtime_songs_edit_unsaved_leave: You have unsaved edits. Save them, or leave again to drop them.
music_runtime_songs_not_here: This song isn't saved in this browser. It may have been imported somewhere else.
music_runtime_songs_shelf_import_hint: {error} Import its score from the path's song list, then come back.
music_runtime_studio_intro: Songs to play, and tools to make your own.
music_runtime_studio_tool_melody_hint: Write lines in the piano roll
music_runtime_tuner_blurb_drone: A held tonic to play scales and long tones against. Press Play drone, then play along.
music_runtime_tuner_blurb_intonation: Hold notes steadily and see how well you stay on pitch over ten seconds.
music_runtime_tuner_blurb_tune: Play one note. The needle shows how far off it is and which way to turn.
music_runtime_tunes_empty_repertoire: No tune is in your repertoire yet. Pass step a on two days to add one.
music_runtime_tunes_intro: You learn every standard in six steps, a to f. Your Check runs mark each step done. A tune with step a done joins your repertoire and comes back for review, as a skill does.
music_runtime_tunes_review_hint: Play steps a and d: the head from the notation, then comp it.
music_runtime_tunes_rung_off_label: {id}, {step}, needs the tune's changes in Jam
music_runtime_tunes_rung_off_title: {step}: Jam has no changes for this tune yet.
music_runtime_tunes_show_all: Every tune on the jazz song list
